facts.text: La Quinta Resort & Club is set beneath the Santa Rosa Mountains.
facts.excerpt: Set beneath the Santa Rosa mountains, La Quinta Resort & Club offers a luxury desert retreat

facts.text: The resort's Spanish-style casitas have private patios and hot tubs.
facts.excerpt: Private patios. Hot tubs. Our Spanish-style casitas are more than just rooms.

facts.text: The casitas, suites and villas sit amid gardens on 45 acres of grounds.
facts.excerpt: Discover our iconic Spanish-style casitas, indulgent suites, and spacious villas nestled amid verdant gardens and 45 acres of pristine grounds.

facts.text: The resort has 42 pools.
facts.excerpt: Discover 42 sparkling pools, each with its own character

facts.text: The resort has 41 climate-controlled pools.
facts.excerpt: La Quinta Resort boasts 41 climate-controlled pools so a refreshing dip is only steps away from each casita

facts.text: PLUNGE at the Renker Pool is a pool reserved for adults.
facts.excerpt: The reimagined PLUNGE at the Renker Pool offers a tranquil, adults-only escape

facts.text: The Main Pool is family-friendly and has views of the Santa Rosa Mountains.
facts.excerpt:
Family-Friendly Environment

Views of the Santa Rosa Mountains

facts.text: Casita pools are located just outside guest rooms.
facts.excerpt: Pools Located Just Outside Rooms

facts.text: The resort has a sunken tournament-style center court for tennis, with USPTA-certified instructors.
facts.excerpt: play in our sunken tournament-style center court, expertly led by our team of USPTA-certified instructors

facts.text: The resort was voted one of the top tennis resorts in the world.
facts.excerpt: Voted one of the top tennis resorts in the world, follow in the footsteps of celebrities and famed players – from Novak Djokovic to Maria Sharapova.

facts.text: La Quinta Resort offers 8 pickleball courts for resort guests and members.
facts.excerpt: La Quinta Resort is proud to offer 8 pickleball courts for resort guests and members.

facts.text: Guests can play golf at the resort's five championship courses.
facts.excerpt: Play one round of golf per night of stay at 1 of our 5 championship courses.

facts.text: The resort's golf courses were named in GOLF's Top 100 Best Courses in North America.
facts.excerpt: Play our legendary courses named in GOLF's Top 100 Best Courses in North America.

facts.text: Spa La Quinta offers water therapies with Vichy showers.
facts.excerpt: Escape into Spa La Quinta’s unique water therapy featuring Lemi’s Aemotio Vichy showers.

facts.text: Spa La Quinta's Garden Bath Ritual is a soak in a private garden tub surrounded by the Santa Rosa Mountains and palm trees.
facts.excerpt: Bask in the surroundings of the Santa Rosa Mountains and the sound of the swaying palm trees as you soak in the splendor of your very own private garden tub.

facts.text: Spa La Quinta has a Sage Room and a Tranquility Garden.
facts.excerpt: enjoy a full pour of your favorite wine from the flight in our Sage Room or Tranquility Garden

facts.text: A History Walk on the 45-acre grounds stops at landmarks including the original Renker pool and the Frank Capra casita.
facts.excerpt:
the original Renker pool,
the waterfall, and the Frank Capra casita

facts.text: Fitness classes are free of charge for resort guests.
facts.excerpt: All classes are offered free of charge to resort guests and to those leasing from La Quinta.

facts.text: The fitness center has 24/7 access.
facts.excerpt: Stay fit on the go with 24/7 access, classes, and personal training.

facts.text: Morgan's in the Desert serves contemporary American cuisine inspired by the Coachella Valley.
facts.excerpt: Morgan’s in the Desert showcases contemporary American cuisine inspired by the bounty of the Coachella Valley.

facts.text: The resort's Mexican restaurant has a traditional Oaxacan motif, a double-sided fireplace and more than 100 tequilas.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in an authentic Mexican dining experience with our traditional Oaxacan motif and double-sided fireplace. Let our talented bartenders create a bespoke margarita – just for you – from 1 of more than 100 tequilas.

facts.text: Starlight Casitas have private balconies for stargazing.
facts.excerpt: Back at your Starlight Casita, unwind under the desert sky. Stargazing from your private balcony is the perfect finish to a fall day.

facts.text: Check-in begins at 4 p.m.
facts.excerpt: Check-in times at La Quinta Resort & Club begin at 4 P.M.

facts.text: Guests under 16 are not permitted in the fitness center or in fitness classes.
facts.excerpt: Guests under 16 are not permitted in the fitness center or in classes.

facts.text: Dogs are not allowed on the pool decks or in the pools.
facts.excerpt: dogs are not allowed on the pool decks or in the water

facts.text: La Quinta Resort & Club was a Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards winner in 2018 and 2019.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2018, 2019

facts.text: The resort calls itself the original desert hideaway.
facts.excerpt: La Quinta Resort & Club, the original desert hideaway, stands out as a storied escape that embodies the romance of classic California

facts.text: Tennis and pickleball courts are available daily from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m.
facts.excerpt: Tennis & Pickleball courts are available daily from 7am to 9pm.
